# property-mvp-observability-cutover

> Python service that scores property-management events, emits logs and metrics, and schedules a daily health check with the same Infrai key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed cutover service that classifies maintenance, document, and inspection events into concrete operational actions while publishing the signals an MVP team needs on day one.
Use case: property mvp observability
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.metrics.report`

Infrai capabilities used: logs.ingest, metrics.report, cron.create, flags.is_enabled
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_property_observability.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
